scripts.dev:all: pnpm --parallel --filter next-inspect-ui --filter next-inspect-ui-deprecated --filter next-inspect-ui-debug --filter next-inspect-website run dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter next-inspect-ui build && pnpm --filter next-inspect-ui-deprecated build && pnpm --filter next-inspect-ui-debug build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter next-inspect-ui typecheck && pnpm --filter next-inspect-ui-deprecated typecheck && pnpm --filter next-inspect-ui-debug typecheck && pnpm --filter next-inspect-website typecheck
scripts.release:debug: pnpm --filter next-inspect-ui-debug exec pnpm publish --access public
